mobbin:d7ecf80a-5cb1-4429-ab2f-b2c40a50f.summary: From the Meetings list, the user accepts a green auto-record banner, chooses 'All meetings' or 'Next meeting', sees a confirmation, and returns with the banner gone.
steps: Meetings list after auto-record is on
steal: A green banner on the recording library offers one action and an X to close it (screen 1), so auto-record is visible without hunting settings.
The banner asks 'All meetings' or 'Next meeting only' (screen 2), so the user can set a lasting default or try one session.
A short message 'Auto-record settings updated' appears at the bottom right (screen 3) without leaving the list.
avoid: Auto-record turns on only from the finished-meetings library (screens 1-4), but sim operators need that choice on the schedule before the session.
mobbin:d7ecf80a-5cb1-4429-ab2f-b2c40a50f.fit: Recording: would sit on Center Overview or room schedule as auto-record by schedule or next session, not a bigger Record button inside the SRV.

mobbin:6b6443d7-dcb9-4e6e-b6a1-d82455a1f.summary: On Coaching playback, the coach adds a scorecard for one speaker, scores Y/N and 1-5 items with notes, submits, and sees it under the video with 'Send to Sam'.
steps: Playback with Scorecard tab and 1-5 rubric
Form with Y/N and 1-5 plus N/A
Note field open under engagement scale
steal: Scorecard sits as a tab under the video (screen 1), so the coach can grade while watching.
Each criterion uses a 1-5 scale that turns red to orange to green, with an 'Avg. score' badge (screen 1).
Before scoring, the coach picks a speaker, template and who can view it (screen 3), so grading is for one learner.
Each item has N/A and 'Add Note', and 'Submit' stays off until answered (screens 4-7).
avoid: The new-scorecard dialog covers the video while grading (screens 3-7), so faculty cannot move through the recording; keep Data Entry beside the player.
mobbin:6b6443d7-dcb9-4e6e-b6a1-d82455a1f.fit: Recording: extends SRV Data Entry into a speaker-limited Scorecard tab under the player, like Abbott, with color 1-5 and send-to-learner.

mobbin:9bc50bc4-4eab-47a8-845f-aeb3a21b4.summary: From 'Scorecard Unavailable', the coach starts 'Score this call', picks a speaker, waits for generation, then reviews AI-filled 1-5 criteria with evidence notes and timestamps.
steps: Speaker menu: Sam or Jane Smith
AI scorecard with avg and 1-5 rows
steal: When AI does not match, the screen says so and still offers 'Score this call' (screen 1), so manual scoring stays available.
The coach must pick a speaker before 'Score' (screens 2-4), so one learner is graded in a multi-person recording.
'Generating Scorecard' shows a progress bar and still offers 'Score this call' (screen 5), so the user is not trapped while waiting.
An expanded criterion shows the AI rationale and a clickable evidence time (screen 7), so the score links to a moment on the timeline.
avoid: Do not auto-apply a sales-pattern scorecard when the meeting 'does not match' (screen 1), because sim rubrics must be faculty-owned checklists, not inferred call patterns.
mobbin:9bc50bc4-4eab-47a8-845f-aeb3a21b4.fit: Recording: adds AI-suggested scores with evidence timestamps into SRV Data Entry. Manual 'Score this call' maps to a rubric not auto-matched to the scenario.
